strings.config.appearance.note: Applies immediately and is remembered (localStorage); “follow system” tracks live OS changes.
strings.config.ctx.note: Set a project code directory; AI scans its tech stack, structure, dependencies and size, then injects that project-level context into the prompt.
strings.config.ctx.note2: Only metadata is scanned — never business source code. If the directory is missing or unset, AI skips this context.
strings.config.llm.key_local: The API key is stored locally only
strings.config.llm.key_local2: and is never sent to any third-party server.
strings.config.llm.models_empty: Not loaded yet. Click “Fetch model list” to retrieve models available from the current API.
strings.config.llm.note: When enabled, the LLM reviews and completes function point types. Connection errors or timeouts fall back to local rules.
strings.config.ops.note: Diagnostics include structured logs, redacted settings and version info (no uploads or outputs). Current data is backed up before import.
strings.config.rates.note: Versions are stored per year (e.g. CSBMK-2023/2024) and selected on the result page. Negative or out-of-range values are rejected.
strings.config.recalc.note: After generating, local Excel can write computed formula results back into the file so viewers that do not recalculate still show values. This is slow (5–20 s), so the default is
strings.config.recalc.note2: : the file is downloadable immediately and replaced once caching finishes.
strings.config.rules.name: Name
strings.config.rules.note: Rules are matched by descending priority; the first hit decides the type. Regex syntax, multiple patterns separated by |. Changes take effect on the next recognition.
strings.config.tpl.note: After uploading, generate a first document with the new template and verify column alignment manually.
strings.config.upd.note: Leave empty to disable version checks. Installing an update preserves local settings.
strings.config.upd.url_label2: ). Detected on startup and when opening Help; a one-click download is offered once a new version is found.
